description: Source code for the CacheItem class, which manages cache entries including their paths, sizes, and deletion (purge) operations within the Android installd component.

classes.name: CacheItem
classes.description: Represents a cache item with properties such as path, size, modification time, and methods to generate string representations and purge the cache item.

methods.name: CacheItem::CacheItem
methods.description: Constructor that initializes a CacheItem object based on an FTSENT pointer, setting properties like level, directory status, size, modification time, and path.

methods.name: CacheItem::toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the cache item, including its path, size, and modification time.

methods.name: CacheItem::buildPath
methods.description: Constructs the full path of the cache item by traversing parent items.

methods.name: CacheItem::purge
methods.description: Deletes the cache item from the filesystem, handling directories and files, with special handling for tombstone markers.
